key_decisions.rationale: Retains startling symmetrical authority.
key_decisions.before: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband; and likewise also the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife.
key_decisions.after: The wife does not have authority over her own body; her husband does. Likewise, the husband does not have authority over his own body; his wife does.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband; and likewise also the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps consent, limited duration, prayer, reunion, and temptation.

key_decisions.after: Do not deprive one another except perhaps by mutual agreement for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer and then come together again, so Satan may not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do not deprive one another, except perhaps by agreement for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer; and then come together again, so that Satan may not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps assigned condition, calling, and universal instruction.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves bodily states and prohibitions.

key_decisions.rationale: Chooses freedom as the consequential opportunity while retaining slavery.
